Priest.note: Spell text from the beta client. Which race gets which spell was first seen in the demo.

Human.name: Divine Grace
Human.description: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1,285 to 1,513 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

Human.name: Feedback
Human.description: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy.  Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned.  Lasts 15 sec.

Dwarf.name: Chastise
Dwarf.meta: 225 Mana, 20 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown
Dwarf.description: Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids.  This spell causes very low threat

Dwarf.name: Desperate Prayer
Dwarf.description: Instantly heals the caster for 1,285 to 1,513.

Night Elf.name: Elune's Grace
Night Elf.meta: 3% of base mana, Instant, 5 min cooldown
Night Elf.description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.
Night Elf.classicNote: (Classic: ranged only, plus dodge, 3 min cooldown.)

Night Elf.name: Starshards
Night Elf.meta: 350 Mana, 30 yd range, Channeled, 30 sec cooldown
Night Elf.description: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1,800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.
Night Elf.classicNote: (Classic: no cooldown and far less damage.)

Gnome.name: Confounding Flash
Gnome.meta: 3% of base mana, 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown
Gnome.description: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.

Gnome.name: Contingency Plan
Gnome.description: Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.

Undead.name: Dark Sacrifice
Undead.description: Cannibalize 1,600 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain 1,600 Mana.

Undead.name: Touch of Weakness
Undead.description: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.

Troll.name: Hex of Weakness
Troll.description: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min
Troll.classicNote: (Classic reduced flat melee damage instead of attack power.)

Troll.name: Shadowguard
Troll.description: Casts a bolt of shadow at the target for 96 Shadow damage.
